tools.name: Google Advanced Search
tools.description: Form that builds site:, filetype:, exact-phrase and date queries without remembering the syntax.

tools.name: Bing
tools.description: A second large index. Its ip: operator lists sites hosted on one address.

tools.name: DuckDuckGo
tools.description: Search without a profile. !bangs jump straight into another site's own search.

tools.name: Brave Search
tools.description: Independent index, so results often differ from Google and Bing.

tools.name: Mojeek
tools.description: Small UK engine with its own crawler. Useful for pages the big engines bury.

tools.name: Yandex
tools.description: Best coverage of the Russian-language web and much of the former USSR.

tools.name: Baidu
tools.description: The main Chinese-language engine.

tools.name: Startpage
tools.description: Google results fetched on your behalf, without tracking. Has an anonymous page viewer.

tools.name: SearXNG instances
tools.description: List of public SearXNG metasearch servers, or host your own.

tools.name: Google Hacking Database
tools.description: Exploit-DB's collection of dorks that surface exposed files, panels and logs.

tools.name: Maigret

tools.name: Blackbird
tools.description: Fast username and email search built on the WhatsMyName list, with PDF/CSV export.

tools.name: social-analyzer
tools.description: CLI, API and web UI that scores how likely each found profile belongs to the same person.

tools.name: Namechk
tools.description: Shows where a name is taken across social sites and domain extensions.

tools.name: Instant Username Search
tools.description: Checks availability on popular platforms as you type.

tools.name: Epieos
tools.description: Turns an email or phone into a Google account, linked services and public profile data.

tools.name: Holehe
tools.description: Checks 120+ sites to see whether an email has an account, without alerting the owner.

tools.name: GHunt
tools.description: Pulls what Google exposes about an account: name, photos, Maps reviews, calendar.

tools.name: Hunter
tools.description: Finds staff addresses for a company domain, the naming pattern and whether a mailbox exists.

tools.name: Gravatar
tools.description: Avatar and profile tied to an email hash. Often leaks a username, photo or website.

tools.name: keys.openpgp.org
tools.description: Verified PGP keyserver. Search an address to find a key and its fingerprint.

tools.name: OSINT Industries
tools.description: Commercial lookup that runs an email, phone or username through hundreds of modules.

tools.name: h8mail
tools.description: Breach hunting for a list of emails, using local dumps or the APIs you have keys for.

tools.name: PhoneInfoga
tools.description: Validates a number, finds carrier and country, and prepares search-engine footprints.

tools.name: libphonenumber demo
tools.description: Google's own parser: is the number valid, which region, mobile or landline.

tools.name: Ignorant
tools.description: Checks whether a number is registered on Instagram, Snapchat and a few others.

tools.name: Truecaller
tools.description: Huge crowdsourced caller-ID directory. Web search needs a sign-in.

tools.name: Sync.ME
tools.description: Caller-ID and spam database with a free web search.

tools.name: Tellows
tools.description: Community spam and scam ratings for numbers, strong across Europe.

tools.name: Free Carrier Lookup
tools.description: Carrier and line type for a number, plus its email-to-SMS gateway.

tools.name: NumLookup
tools.description: Free reverse lookup, mostly useful for US numbers.

tools.name: Pipl
tools.description: Identity resolution that links emails, phones and profiles. Sold to vetted businesses.

tools.name: IDCrawl
tools.description: Free people search that groups social profiles and photos under one name.

tools.name: TruePeopleSearch
tools.description: US people search: addresses, phones and relatives from public records.

tools.name: FastPeopleSearch
tools.description: Another free US records aggregator, handy for cross-checking.

tools.name: That's Them
tools.description: US reverse lookup by name, address, phone, email or IP.

tools.name: Radaris
tools.description: US background profiles that join property, court and contact records.

tools.name: 192.com
tools.description: UK electoral roll, directors and phone directory search.

tools.name: FamilySearch
tools.description: Free genealogy archive: births, marriages, census and church books from many countries.

tools.name: Find a Grave
tools.description: Volunteer-built burial records with photos and family links.

tools.name: Legacy.com
tools.description: Obituary archive. Obituaries name relatives, towns and employers.

tools.name: X Advanced Search
tools.description: Native search by account, phrase, date range and engagement. Needs a logged-in account.

tools.name: Bluesky search
tools.description: Search Bluesky posts and people; from:, since: and until: operators work.

tools.name: Who posted what?
tools.description: Builds Facebook keyword searches limited to a date or a single profile.

tools.name: Social Searcher
tools.description: Mentions of a keyword across social networks and the web, with sentiment.

tools.name: TGStat
tools.description: Catalogue and analytics of Telegram channels and chats, with post search.

tools.name: Arctic Shift
tools.description: Search archived Reddit posts and comments, including some that were later deleted.

tools.name: Instaloader
tools.description: Downloads public Instagram profiles, posts, stories and their metadata.

tools.name: Snap Map
tools.description: Public Snapchat stories placed on a live map. Good for breaking events.

tools.name: SteamID I/O
tools.description: Converts a Steam profile URL into every ID format, to follow a gamer across sites.

tools.name: crt.sh
tools.description: Certificate Transparency search. Every certificate ever issued for a domain, so subdomains too.

tools.name: DNSDumpster
tools.description: Maps a domain's DNS records, hosts and subdomains into one diagram.

tools.name: SecurityTrails
tools.description: Historical DNS and WHOIS, plus subdomains and associated domains.

tools.name: ViewDNS.info
tools.description: Many small tools in one place: reverse IP, reverse WHOIS, IP history, DNS report.

tools.name: ICANN Lookup
tools.description: Official RDAP lookup: registrar, dates and status straight from the registry.

tools.name: DomainTools WHOIS
tools.description: Clean WHOIS view. History and reverse WHOIS are in the paid product.

tools.name: BuiltWith
tools.description: Technology profile of a site, including analytics and ad IDs that link sites to one owner.

tools.name: Wappalyzer
tools.description: Browser extension that names the CMS, frameworks and trackers of the page you are on.

tools.name: Netcraft Site Report
tools.description: Hosting history, netblock owner and first-seen date for a site.

tools.name: DNSlytics
tools.description: Reverse lookups by IP, name server, mail server or Google Analytics ID.

tools.name: MxToolbox
tools.description: DNS, MX, SPF, DMARC and blocklist checks in one place.

tools.name: Robtex
tools.description: Graph of how a domain, its IPs, name servers and ASN connect.

tools.name: Whoxy
tools.description: Low-cost WHOIS history and reverse WHOIS by name, email or company.

tools.name: Subfinder
tools.description: Passive subdomain discovery from dozens of public sources. Fast and pipe-friendly.

tools.name: OWASP Amass
tools.description: Deep attack-surface mapping: subdomains, ASNs and relationships in a graph database.

tools.name: theHarvester
tools.description: Collects emails, names, subdomains and hosts for a domain from public sources.

tools.name: dnstwist
tools.description: Generates lookalike domains and shows which are registered. Catches phishing setups.

tools.name: domain-recon
tools.description: Passive DNS, RDAP, email spoofing, TLS, CT subdomains and lookalikes, with dark HTML reports.

tools.name: Google Safe Browsing status
tools.description: Whether Google currently flags a site as malicious or deceptive.

tools.name: Shodan
tools.description: Search engine for exposed devices: open ports, banners, webcams, industrial systems.

tools.name: Censys
tools.description: Internet-wide scan data on hosts, services and certificates.

tools.name: Netlas
tools.description: Hosts, DNS, WHOIS and certificates from its own scans, with a generous free tier.

tools.name: ONYPHE
tools.description: French attack-surface search engine built on scans and threat feeds.

tools.name: FOFA
tools.description: Chinese asset search engine with strong coverage of Asian networks.

tools.name: GreyNoise
tools.description: Tells you if an IP is background noise: a mass scanner, a known bot or a benign crawler.

tools.name: AbuseIPDB
tools.description: Community abuse reports: brute force, spam, scanning. Shows ISP and usage type.

tools.name: IPinfo
tools.description: Geolocation, ASN, company and VPN/hosting flags for an IP.

tools.name: Spur
tools.description: Detects VPNs, residential proxies and which anonymity service an IP belongs to.

tools.name: Hurricane Electric BGP Toolkit
tools.description: ASNs, prefixes, peers and routing data. Who really owns a netblock.

tools.name: RIPEstat

tools.name: WiGLE
tools.description: Crowdsourced map of Wi-Fi networks and cell towers. Locate an SSID or BSSID.

tools.name: Wayback Machine

tools.name: archive.today
tools.description: On-demand snapshots that often capture pages the Wayback Machine cannot.

tools.name: Ghostarchive
tools.description: Archive that keeps videos and social media posts alongside pages.

tools.name: Arquivo.pt

tools.name: Common Crawl
tools.description: Free monthly crawl of billions of pages, queryable by URL through its index.

tools.name: waybackurls

tools.name: ArchiveBox
tools.description: Self-hosted archiver: saves pages as HTML, PDF, screenshot and WARC on your own disk.

tools.name: Visualping
tools.description: Watches a page and emails you when it changes.

tools.name: Google Lens
tools.description: Reverse image search with strong object, text and landmark recognition.

tools.name: Bing Visual Search
tools.description: Reverse image search with crop-to-region. Finds matches the others miss.

tools.name: Yandex Images
tools.description: Reverse search that is unusually good at buildings, landscapes and faces.

tools.name: TinEye

tools.name: PimEyes

tools.name: Search by Image

tools.name: ExifTool

tools.name: FotoForensics

tools.name: Forensically

tools.name: InVID-WeVerify plugin

tools.name: yt-dlp

tools.name: Watch Frame by Frame

tools.name: Google Earth

tools.name: Google Maps

tools.name: Mapillary

tools.name: KartaView
tools.description: Open street-level imagery collected by volunteers.

tools.name: Yandex Maps

tools.name: OpenStreetMap

tools.name: PeakVisor

tools.name: Zoom Earth

tools.name: GeoNames

tools.name: OpenCelliD

tools.name: Liveuamap

tools.name: Global Fishing Watch

tools.name: Flightradar24
